description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git config'. It defines setup functions, various test cases, and validation checks to ensure correct handling of configuration entries in git repositories.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by creating a minimal git config with a specific section and key.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Verifies that the value for a given section.key in git config matches the expected value.

methods.name: check_regex
methods.description: Checks that the value for a section.key matches a provided regex and equals the expected value.
